name: engineering-blog
description: Blog about industrial engineering, systems engineering, and data science - Refactored Edition

scripts.build:production: NODE_ENV=production node build.js && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.build:test: NODE_ENV=test node build.js && JEKYLL_ENV=test bundle exec jekyll build --drafts --future
scripts.dev: npm run build && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
scripts.optimize:assets: npm run minify && npm run gzip
scripts.gzip: npm run build && find _site -type f \( -name "*.html" -o -name "*.css" -o -name "*.js" \) -not -name "*.gz" -exec gzip -k -f -9 {} \; || true
scripts.test: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:unit
scripts.audit:performance: echo 'Performance audit skipped - use Lighthouse CI in GitHub Actions' || true
scripts.analyze:size: npm run build && du -sh _site/ && find _site/ -name '*.js' -exec wc -c {} + | sort -n
scripts.report:build: npm run build && echo 'Build report generated' && [ -f build-stats.json ] && cat build-stats.json || echo 'No build stats available'
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run test

author: DominicusIn
